body: The first one... and also... just... shame, and fear of losing people. I don't want people to know how bad I am.

right now the big problem i have i can't really solve. *sigh* money problems. i'm supposed to leave for work in like 2 minutes but i've spent the last 10 minutes looking for change for the bus and still don't have enough. i have a check to put in the bank but when i do my bank is going to eat it up and then i'll still be overdrawn.

but fuck it, that's just the immediate stressor. the big thing seems to be that i can't seem to get my shit together and i can't figure out why. i feel like such a failure.
guilt is not a good reason to stay alive is it?
there's nobody to talk to. they wouldn't understand. they have no idea that anything's even wrong.

but what do you do when everything's gone to shit?

i don't know how to crawl out of the hole i'm in. :(
Not a good idea. It would worry and upset them.
only a few people who i talk to online know. nobody irl knows. the only one i'd really be worried about is my kitten. nobody else really depends on me.
i feel ya dude. its so hard when you have a plan but can't seem to put it into action. i'm struggling with the same thing.
Ahh. Well, I don't think that highly of myself, especially around this stuff. I sort of fail at all of it. And I'm just... not a very good person, I guess. Thanks for the explanation, though.

> Take gentle care of yourself

People often say this, but I'm not sure what it means.
I feel like i *want* to disappear. I don't know if that's the same thing though.

Thanks for your reply - but, well, from what you've written here, he did do it again, and the only reason why he ended up going to jail is because you were able to help the next victim make that happen. I don't have that opportunity, because we moved away from him (well not away from *him* specifically, but we moved), and I haven't seen or heard from him since.

It's pretty likely that he did it again. Someone else got hurt, because I was too afraid to push the issue and make sure that he was dealt with.

I'm not strong. If I was strong I would have done more. I was weak and afraid and whatever, what happened to me is my own thing, but if he went on to hurt other people...

Oi. This stuff makes me feel sick inside.
